label: GDP
description: Gross domestic product in current US dollars, annual rate.

label: Real GDP
description: Gross domestic product in constant 1949 dollars, annual rate. Strips out inflation.

label: Real growth
description: Change in inflation-adjusted GDP over the past year.

label: Inflation
description: Change in consumer prices over the past year.

label: Unemployment
description: Share of the labour force out of work and seeking work.

label: Interest rate
description: Short-term Treasury bill rate. Until the Fed wins its independence, it is pegged to hold down the cost of government debt.

label: Budget balance
description: Central government receipts minus outlays, annual rate. Positive is a surplus.

label: Public debt
description: Central government debt held by the public.

label: Debt to GDP
description: Public debt as a share of nominal GDP.

label: Gold reserves
description: Monetary gold stock valued at the official price of $35 per troy ounce.

label: Industrial production
description: Real output of heavy industry, energy, consumer goods and technology, weighted by value added. Index, 1949 = 100.

label: Steel output
description: Crude steel production, million metric tonnes per year.

label: Savings overhang
description: Money households hold because there was nothing to buy: repressed inflation in an economy with fixed prices. Valued at 1949 US prices.

label: Active personnel
description: Active-duty members of the armed forces.

label: Consumer shortages
description: Share of what households tried to buy that the shops could not supply: queues and empty shelves.
